text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to push console v2.4.1 frontend assets to CDN in the 18:00 UTC window (today). Target window 18:00–18:20. Wanted to confirm who can perform the deploy and run smoke checks. @sam?

sam: I'm available, will kick off at 18:00 UTC. Plan: upload assets -> edge invalidation -> canary 2% for 10m -> promote. Will run smoke steps and watch metrics. :rocket:

elaine: +1. Please stagger static/JS purge to avoid traffic spikes. Start with /_next/static/* then icons/images. Also please keep new-nav FF off for first canary.

sam: noted — FF new-nav will be off. deploy steps I'll run:
1) `ship-assets --env=prod --tag=v2.4.1`
2) Purge edges
3) Promote canary -> 100% if healthy

sam: CDN purge curl (for ops reference):
```
curl -X POST https://cdn.api/internal/purge -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CDN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"paths":["/_next/static/*","/assets/icons/*"]}'
```

ton y: I'll be on logs and Sentry watch. If error rate > 5% or 502 spikes, I'll trigger rollback. Slack ping + rollback command ready: `deploy rollback console v2.4.1`

maria: preflight checklist:
- assets built + hashes ✅
- CDN token in Secrets ✅
- smoke scripts in /ops/smoke/console.sh ✅
- runbook updated with rollback steps ✅

sam: running quick local smoke now, posting results:
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://console.redwood.ai/health` -> 200
`curl -s https://console.redwood.ai/ | grep 'app-root'` -> found
smoke script returns OK :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam at 18:00 UTC. ID: dpl-20260317-801. Canary route: 2% -> promotion window 10m.

elaine: reminder — after purge, do a lightweight prime pass to /_next/static/chunks/main-*.js and /favicon.ico (curl in parallel) so first users don't get cold fetches.

sam: will run parallel prime: `xargs -n1 -P8 curl -s -I < prime-list.txt` — done after purge.

tony: if we need to rollback quick: steps:
1) `deploy rollback dpl-20260317-801`
2) clear canary rule
3) revert CDN purge if feasible (edge cache TTL fallback)
I'll announce in #eng-releases and call in @maria.

maria: thanks all. I'll be on standby 17:50–19:00 UTC. Post smoke pass and final promote once 2% is stable for 10m. :eyes:
